name: nginx-multisite
description: Provisions Nginx as a multi-site HTTP/HTTPS server for three virtual hosts, including document roots, sample content, security settings, Fail2ban, UFW, SSH hardening, and development self-signed certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis on port 6379, creates its log directory, and applies the required Redis configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, provisions its database and environment configuration, and runs it under systemd/Uvicorn on port 8000.
